diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 3.3 V, datasheet reading 4.5 V
diffs.evidence: The M5Stack U029 page gives no supply-voltage range (only the PORT.A pin label 'GND 5V SDA SCL'), so the 4.5 V reading is inferred from that label; the vendor schematic (Unit_Heart_page_01.png) shows the HT7533 VIN and the R3/R4 4.7 kOhm SDA/SCL pull-ups both on VCC, so the model deliberately runs it from 3.3 V for 3.3 V hosts, which still works because the HT7533 drops only 'VDIF Voltage Drop IOUT=1mA 100 mV' (about 3.2 V out) and the MAX30100 needs 'VLED+ Guaranteed by PSRR of LED Driver 3.1 3.3 5.0 V' while its 1.8 V VDD comes from the RT9193.
